audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 1, 2 and 6 read 'Skill' in both layers, against the already-audited Trundle side which set the chart to Trundle / Trundle / Skill / Ryze / Ryze / Skill / Ryze.
audit.why: Ryze has one ability at level 1 against a 3.5-second Chomp that saps his AD, and at level 2 Rune Prison still only slows unless Spell Flux landed first — Frozen Domain out-brawls that. Level 6 is Ryze's because Realm Warp is real map tempo even though it is not an escape.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 1 -> Trundle, row 4 -> Ryze, as matched full/content pairs with ratings; whys[1] rewritten so it no longer claims level 2 tips toward Ryze.

audit.why: Level 3 (loop online), the first mana item, and two items are the Ryze steps; Trundle front-loads and then falls off, which is what the corrected chart now shows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chomp was described only as 'his Q bite' — the packet flags it as an auto-attack reset, which is the actual burst tell, and it runs on a flat 3.5 seconds at 300 range. Subjugate's cooldown (120/100/80) and the fact that the stolen health, armour and MR DOUBLE over 4 seconds were nowhere on the page, even though every green-light line is keyed to it. Pillar of Ice never appeared at all.
audit.why: The packet's only listed defect is 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' — these three numbers are the sequencing. The doubling clause in particular changes the instruction from 'never duel into R' to 'break the duel inside four seconds', which is a thing a player can actually do.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, spikes[0].text and dontsFull[0].d now carry the auto-reset tell, Subjugate's cooldown and doubling window, and Pillar of Ice's 1000-range retreat cut.
sources: brief:enemyKit Q/E/R text, cds and flags

audit.whatIsWrong: The terrain-cuts-retreat and autoreset-burst-tell interactions were both absent; needs-antiheal is already covered by report[8].t.
audit.why: Ryze has no dash, so an impassable pillar dropped behind him at 1000 range on a 21-second cooldown is the kill setup, and the Chomp reset is what tells you the burst has started.
audit.corrected: Both stated, in dontsFull[0].d and spikes[0].text respectively.

edits.before: Steals your resists and HP — never take a long duel into it. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Subjugate is 120s at rank 1 and the steal doubles over 4 seconds — leave before it finishes.

edits.before: Track Trundle’s Subjugate: Steals your resists and HP — never take a long duel into it. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Subjugate (120s at rank 1): the HP, armour and MR it steals doubles over 4 seconds — break the duel inside that window.

edits.before: That’s Trundle’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Pillar of Ice walls off your retreat at 1000 range and you have no dash.

edits.before: Trundle's Q bite steals your AD and his W movement zone lets him stick to you — no W root yet means you lose any extended scrap he initiates.
edits.after: Chomp is an auto-attack reset on 3.5s that saps your AD — the wind-up is your cue to step back, and with no W root yet you lose any extended scrap.

edits.before: W root is now online, making his step-up cost him a root plus empowered Q slow — the 50/50 trade tips toward you if you punish his aggression immediately.
edits.after: W root arrives on an 11-second cooldown, but unfluxed it only slows — lead with E or his Chomp bite and Frozen Domain still win the level-2 brawl.

notes: Chart follows the already-audited Trundle side rather than the packet, which differed at rows 1, 5 and 6 — per the mirror rule. Two claims carried over from that side as unverified and still not written here: whether Pillar of Ice's terrain blocks Overload's projectile, and whether Realm Warp's portal can be placed across terrain it creates. Also unchanged but worth noting: wants.foe[2] cites 'Grasp' on Trundle, which is a rune assumption, not a kit fact, and late/whys[6] refer to a 'Seraph's shield' — Seraph's Embrace on Ryze is a mana/AP item and the shield framing may be another instance of the invented-shield error the Teemo mirror flagged across this champion.
